blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Datu Victorino “Migketay” Saway, the supreme chieftain of the Talaandig tribe in Bukidnon and a towering figure in Mindanao’s indigenous rights movement, has died. He was 72. Saway, widely regarded as a cultural vanguard and peacemaker, dedicated his life to defending the ancestral domains of Mount Kitanglad and championing indigenous self-determination. “Graduated from the physical realm into the realm of our ancestors,” his daughter, Aduna Saway, wrote in a poignant tribute confirming his passing. “May the heroes of Nalandangan greet you with a Sagyawan – a resounding yell of victory.
